tools.name: refuel_gas
tools.description: Stuck without gas? Get a small amount of the native gas token (ETH on Base/Arbitrum/Optimism/Ethereum, SOL, BNB, POL, AVAX, TRX, TON, SUI...) delivered to any address, paid with whatever token you hold on any chain. Default $3 worth.

tools.name: compare_quotes

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Free USD prices for tokens across 25+ chains in one call. No API key, no rate-limit sign-up. Filter by symbols (e.g. ['BTC','ETH','SOL']) and/or chain.

tools.name: search_tokens

tools.name: list_chains

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_swap_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check a swap by deposit address. Set wait_seconds (up to 25) and the server waits for the status to change before answering, so you need fewer calls. Statuses: …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pay, create_spending_policy · Private data: pay, get_quote, create_swap, pay_exact, fund_x402, create_payment_link, create_paywall, create_spending_policy, refuel_gas, get_prices, search_tokens, list_chains · Public sink: pay, create_swap, pay_exact, get_receipt, buy_access · Destructive: set_policy_enabled.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pay, create_spending_policy · Private data: pay, get_quote, create_swap, pay_exact, fund_x402, create_payment_link, create_paywall, create_spending_policy, refuel_gas, get_prices, search_tokens, list_chains · Public sink: pay, create_swap, pay_exact, get_receipt, buy_access · Destructive: set_policy_enabled

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
